title: Binary sparse coding
description: Make SAE latents binary: an active latent always decodes to the same vector (its direction times a learned scale), trained with a straight-through estimator. Binary latents cannot represent a feature at many magnitudes, which the paper argues removes uninterpretable high-frequency latents. Prediction: planted directions are recovered at least as well as with a TopK SAE, even though reconstruction gets worse because real feature magnitudes vary.
